text:
I'm sorry, that's a awful thing to receive, especially when you needed it for an event. Unfortunately, because the weather hold was waived, cold damage in transit isn't covered by the Plant Care Guarantee, and DOA claims for cold or heat damage aren't accepted, so I can't offer a free replacement for this one.

If you think something else went wrong (for example, the hold was never offered or the plant wasn't exposed to the cold in transit), I can escalate your case to a Support Lead for review. I can also connect you with a Plant Care Specialist for free care advice if any part of the plant looks salvageable.
